in_marathi.name: Chitrahar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Skilled artist, painter
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chitrahar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit words 'chitra' (painting, picture) and 'har' (remover of sorrow). Chitrahar is a name given to a skilled artist or a painter. It is believed that through their art, Chitrahar's bring joy and relief to people.
